scope: Dormant StudioLoader wrapper and HOC in actual React DOM with installed Query v5, controlled HTTP/reporting boundaries; no routed-page/provider/backend-delivery claim
remainingBranchExplanation: loadingState has five fixed keys on every construction and update; totalItems || 1 fallback at StudioLoader.tsx:66 cannot be reached through the public component contract. Retained unchanged; no fake hits or exclusion.
assertedBehaviors: Pending query shows skeleton without child controls
Real query success updates progress and shows child controls and success announcement

Independent sample-only and project-only degraded modes retain controls and recover
Timeout, generic and missing-message rejection presentations
Successful creation sends exact POST body and awaits all three real QueryClient invalidations
Actual window.location.reload reconstructs the component and loads again
Settled component unmount clears rendered controls
integrity: Every executed bundle script ID is SHA256-verified before discarded context reuse
Original source contents match source-map contents and current source hash
Precise coverage snapshots reset counters and merge only byte-identical bundles across actual reload
All artifact hashes match producer provenance
